(Mmm-mmm)

You held me before I knew your name
Before I could talk, before I could explain
You watched me grow from your arms to my own feet

You were there for every ordinary day
For scraped-up knees and tears I couldn't say
For every smile, every dream I brought to your door

I don't think I'll ever find the words
